sections.title: Overview
descriptions: This page brings together available employment and compensation records related to Caleb M. Kinnaman. He was one of the officer involved in the Cody Greenland Encounter.

sections.title: Employment
descriptions: Officer Kinnaman began working for the American Fork Police Department on September 10, 2019.

sections.title: Related Police Encounters
descriptions: Officer Kinnaman was involved in the arrest of Cody Greenland. According to Greenland’s federal complaint, Kinnaman helped hold Greenland on the ground while Lieutenant Quinn Adamson used a Taser against him. Greenland later named Kinnaman, Adamson, Blackburn, and Cannon as defendants in a federal civil-rights lawsuit.
